reviewer_role: independent structural/numeric/archive track; not a semantic label generator
scope: Raw census, frozen K boundary, non-K coverage, relation closure, review-chain closure, grouping closure, report text, and citation anchors.

findings.reason: Raw baseline census closes at 512 reports and the inventory contains both sides' 1783 items.
All frozen non-K reports have exactly one v3 decision.
The 279-row frozen K projection is byte-content identical to v2.
All v3 decisions point to the exact raw record and finding pointer.
Every v3 row has 145 relation rows, two blind proposals, final pane5 confirmation, and a closed arbitration pointer.
All 233 pane5 decisions have addressable arbitration records; disagreement entries=146.
Canonical decisions contain neither excluded broad Track-B artifacts nor legacy reviewer identities.
Every final N/I report belongs to exactly one same-side, pair-local group/diagnostic cluster.
Combined projection contains 279 frozen K rows plus 233 v3 non-K rows.
All six cited DOI anchors are present and the protocol states the project rule is an operationalization, not a verbatim single-paper definition.
Report-facing text names the v3 baseline layer, frozen boundary, and not_applicable distinctions.

limitations: This track does not replace source-semantic pane5 adjudication or the independent semantic reviewer; it only verifies persisted closure and publication contracts.
